messages:
Maya: :rotating_light: paging ops-oncall — we're seeing a spike in 5xxs for the embeddings endpoint from a subset of AZs (az-east-2b/2c). customers reporting timeouts and rate errors.
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0312-01 — Severity: P1 (partial regional outage). Pager oncall: Maya.
Maya: quick context: started ~15:25 UTC, error rate ~20-30% overall but 80-90% coming from az-east-2 subnets. health checks show NAT gateway errors and some DNS resolution timeouts to our internal redis cluster.
Alex: I'm on it. checking VPC route tables and NACL changes now.
Samir: I can pull flow logs + recent infra changes. wondering if yesterday's automation PR that rotated NACLs for cost reasons landed in that AZ.
Irene: Noted impact: embedding calls for multi-tenant customers A, C, and internal batch jobs are failing. Customer dashboards show increased latency and retries.
Alex: AWS console shows recent Network ACL update at 15:10 UTC for VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d in az-east-2 subnets. The rule inserted was a DENY for ephemeral port range 1024-65535 for outbound. looks like a templating bug.
Maya: :facepalm: That would break NAT egress and DNS. Samir, can you confirm when the change was applied and by which automation run?
Samir: Checking CI/CD logs... found a merged job: infra/nacl-rotation at 15:09 UTC from pipeline #8423 (author: infra-bot). It replaced NACL egress to explicit allow for a narrow set but default deny for others — bad template.
Alex: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert NACL to previous state (replace-network-acl-entry) 2) add temporary route to a standby NAT instance in the same AZ for affected subnets 3) restart local DNS cache on app proxies.
Irene: I'll notify Support and CS that we're mitigating and to brace for followups. Customer impact: high for long-running embedding jobs; low for small token generation.
Maya: Alex, Samir — can you apply the revert? I'll coordinate page/exec updates.
Samir: Reverting NACL now. Command I'm running:```bash
aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc1234 --rule-number 100 --egress --protocol -1 --rule-action allow --cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0
```
Alex: Adding route to nat-standby in route table rtb-0def5678 for the affected private subnets as a fallback:```bash
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0def5678 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --instance-id i-0standbynat
```
IncidentBot: NOTE: automatic paging escalation in 10m if no status update.
Maya: Good call to add temporary route — keep it in place until NACL is validated. Samir, any logs showing DNS timeouts?
Samir: Yes — here are recent logs from proxy-local: "dial tcp: lookup redis-primary: no such host" and "i/o timeout connecting to 10.12.8.5:6379". After NACL revert, we'll need to validate DNS resolution across AZs.
Alex: NACL revert completed at 15:48 UTC. I'm running connectivity checks: `curl -sS -m 2 http://metadata` and internal redis ping.
Maya: Running smoke tests against embeddings endpoint now. Samir, can you watch metrics?
Samir: Metrics show drop in 5xxs from 18% -> 6% in az-east-2 within 3 minutes of revert. DNS latency also reduced.
Irene: Support notified customers A/C with high-level summary and ETA for full recovery.
Maya: Ok, starting controlled rollback of the temporary route in 15m if stability holds. Leave the nat-standby route for now as an emergency fallback.
Alex: I'll keep an eye on the automation pipeline — opened a ticket to prevent infra-bot from applying the bad template again (infra#4521).
Maya: Handoff: I'm going offline in 30m. Samir, can you take next oncall shift and continue monitoring? Please do a full sweep of all AZ NACLs and route tables and coordinate with infra eng to revert automation.
Samir: Taking handoff. Will run full audit script and post results in this thread.
IncidentBot: Handoff recorded: Maya -> Samir at 16:05 UTC.
Irene: Customer impact post-mitigation: estimated 1200 failed requests across 3 customers during the window (~15:20-15:48 UTC). No data loss. Recommended postmortem: include CI/CD gating for NACL templates, add test harness that simulates outbound egress during NACL changes, and ops playbook revision.
Maya: Agreed. I'll create the incident ticket and assign owners for followups. Thanks all for fast mitigation. :tada:
Samir: Audit run started — posting full output shortly.
Alex: Logging the remediation commands and timestamps into the incident doc.
Irene: Support will follow up with impacted customers with a timeline and credits if requested.
Maya: Closing the active paging loop — will reopen if anything regresses.
Samir: (post-handoff) audit summary: 4 subnets had modified NACL entries in az-east-2, automation PR caused incorrect rule ordering. Full rollback confirmed.
Maya: Postmortem owners assigned: infra (template gating), devex (automation bot perms), ops (runbook updates). Will sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0312-01 status -> Resolved (recovered connectivity, monitoring in watch).
